Want to stay on the trail — or the beach, campsite, or wherever the outdoors takes you — without your body pushing back? This channel is for outdoor lovers of all kinds: trail runners, backpackers, and hikers logging serious miles, plus families and weekend warriors who just want beach trips, camping, and playing outside without pain in the way.
Hosted by the sports rehab and sports chiropractic specialists at Performance Place Sports Care in Costa Mesa, CA, we skip generic advice and tackle real training load and biomechanics head-on.
We break down evidence-based rehab for the conditions that sideline active people: lower back pain, hip impingement (FAI), labral tears, sports hernias, plantar fasciitis, and patellofemoral knee pain.
Manage your conditions, move better, and protect your time outside. Visit our Costa Mesa clinic or work with us virtually through multi-state telehealth. Subscribe for practical tips and clinical strategies.
